geometryBasis: The named OSM way provides an 8.58 by 7.70 m bounding rectangle. The south entrance view and east apse view determine the main roof and wall offsets and the round apse. The two views share one documented appearance date.
sectionBasis: Exterior wall heights, the side doorway, drum and dome rise estimated from photographic proportions. Original public terrain places the doorway threshold within its local grade. Model units are metres.
